ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized in scars and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black ground across both lobes; localized high-contrast white circular clusters at distal tips; sparse white mottling and linear streaks distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 35-40 degrees; vertical depth occupies approximately 15% of visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels creating a jagged contour, most pronounced on the right lobe distal section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; smaller scattered circular white spots visible in the mid-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned linear white streaks; prominent 45-degree diagonal markings on the left lobe; intersecting horizontal and vertical linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant distal tip barnacle colonization; dense multi-directional rake marks/abrasions covering approximately 40% of the visible surface area.
